name: Custom Shape Hologram Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Dazzling starburst/broken glass holographic acrylic catches and scatters light in a starburst/broken glass pattern, creating a brilliant, radiant glow that shifts as it moves. This stunning light play makes it perfect for holiday decorations, personalized gifts, or standout accessories.
  • High-quality Material
  • 1 Layered Hologram Glass Ornament 3mm-thick hologram acrylic featuring a brilliant starburst or broken glass pattern effect
  • 2 Layered Hologram Glass Ornament: 2 layers of 3mm-thick hologram acrylic featuring a brilliant starburst or broken glass pattern effect
  • 2 Layered Hologram Glass and Wood Ornament: 3mm-thick plywood and 3mm-thick hologram acrylic featuring a brilliant starburst effect to create a dynamic, eye-catching display that changes with the light!
  • Multiple Sizes (3.5in - 8in) : Choose from a variety of sizes to match different display needs. Smaller sizes are perfect for tree decorations, gift tags, or car charms, while larger sizes work beautifully as window hangings, wall art, or statement pieces.
  • You can hang it on your rearview mirror as a car decoration, auto decoration, vehicle accessory, automobile accessory, or display it as home decoration wherever you like. This handy ornament is the perfect size to display in your vehicle, on your bag, or in your living room, bedroom, or workroom. Come with a hole and metal wire attached to the strap.
  • Gift of love: A perfect idea if you are finding a birthday gift, a housewarming gift, a festival gift, a Mother’s Day/ Father’s Day/ Christmas gift for your family or friends.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape Hologram Ornament

 

PRODUCTION

  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Please allow 0.5-2 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
